# Draft:Lokeshwar Dev

----
Untold Story of M/s Stockguru.India
Chapter One.
Introduction
Lokeshwar Dev alias Ulhas Khaire was born in Nagpur, Maharashtra in 1980. He completed his SSC from Saraswati Vidyalaya, Nagpur and HSC from Ambedkar College. BA from IGNOU. Completed MD (AM) from IIAM, RMP From IBAM, Kolkata, DPC from TGI, Kolkata, CHR & CFN from IGNOU.
Currently pursuing his regular LLB Degree from Bundelkhand University.
Belong to Higher Middle Class Family. Grand son of IAS Officer Sh. V S Khaire (Retd. District Collector) and Son of Government Employee Mrs. Kamal Khaire and son of prominent Liquor Tycoon Prabhakar Khaire. (PVK Group), He has a Total Net worth of Rs approximately 500 Crores. Owner of Luxury  Fleet of Vehicles such as Toyota Land Cruiser, Mercedes Benz, Toyota Camry, Ford Endeavor, Honda City, Scorpio etc. Owns Luxury Villa in Goa and Presidential Suite in Greater Noida. Beside he own multiple Flats and Plots Across India in cities like Delhi, Greater Noida, Bhiwadi, Moradabad, Ratnagiri & Goa. Started a small firm M/s Stockguru.India in 1999 as proprietary concern which was later converted to Partnership firm and lastly was in process to merge with a public limited company namely M/s SGI Research & Analysis Limited. From 2009 to 2011 M/s Stockguru.India was India's one of the Leading and Premier Financial Consulting Firms offering its vast base of 2 Lacs plus clients Stock Trading Tips for Rs 10,000/- and multiple of 10,000/- and was also providing Training Programs which was ranging from Rs 10,000/- (Ten Thousand Only) to Rs 60,00,000/- (Sixty Lacs).
